summary: Add the missing teaching sequence, an endothermic pathway, and focused calorimetry practice.

improvements.why: The syllabus gate reports no teaching card for all seven outcomes, so lesson mode lacks its motivate, discover, establish, connect, note and self-explanation sequence.
improvements.what: Add one complete, accurate teaching card per KC, each with a misconception-sensitive discover MCQ; use the definitions, diagrams and worked methods already in the pack and note.

improvements.where: note, after the existing exothermic profile in ## Key ideas
improvements.why: 9701-5.1.2 asks learners to construct and interpret pathway diagrams, but the only drawn example is exothermic.
improvements.what: Add an energy_profile for an endothermic reaction, with products above reactants and clear forward activation-energy and positive $\Delta H$ labels; add a sentence comparing the two profiles.

improvements.where: note, after the bond-energy worked example
improvements.why: The method gives $q=mc\Delta T$ and $\Delta H=-q/n$ but the note never works an experimental enthalpy calculation from measurements.
improvements.what: Add a compact worked calorimetry example: use total heated solution mass, calculate $\Delta T$ and $q$ in joules, determine the limiting reactant and the correct mole basis, then convert to $\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ with the reaction sign. Include the one-mole-of-water basis if neutralisation is used.

improvements.why: Core practice has short numerical and MCQ items, but no written sketch of an endothermic profile or multistep experimental enthalpy problem.
improvements.what: Add one exam-style structured sketch/interpret item assessing reactant and product levels, $E_a$ and signed $\Delta H$; add one structured calorimetry item assessing heated mass, limiting moles, joule-to-kilojoule conversion and sign, with hints and mark schemes.
